description: Save a domain's DNS records as a BIND zone file (RFC 1035) in this server's outbox: every record list_dns_records returns, under `$ORIGIN <domain>.`, host names absolute, MX and SRV with their priority, TXT text quoted in 255-byte strings, each record's notes as a comment. Porkbun answers with its own SOA, so the file has none. The answer gives the file's path, size and sha256, and how many records of each type it holds. Use it as a backup before a large change, or to move the zone to another DNS host; import_dns_records takes the file back with `zone_file`. This server has no outbox yet (PORKBUN_OUTBOX_DIR), so the call fails until one is set.

domain.description: A domain in the account, e.g. `example.com`.

save_dir.description: A folder inside the outbox to save into (created if missing). Default: the outbox itself.

name: export_dns_zone
